comment: The CHEM-time knob is declared as P_NOTHING in Core.hpp and is turned by the module itself in Core.cpp:1062-1068; no code reads its value. The four surface outputs take 14 channels from MIDI channels 2 to 15 by default, or 16 channels from every channel when MPE mode is turned off on the Core actions menu (Core.cpp:1091). Menu items live on the Core actions hamburger button on the panel, not in the module's right-click menu, which carries only themes, screws and theme reloading.
